top_signals.title: Asian Stocks Rise as Oil Slides After US Election: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks advanced, tracking gains in US equities after a Democratic sweep in the US midterm elections sent oil plunging on speculation the conflict with Iran will end sooner.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Visible Crude Loadings Halt, Iran’s Empty Tankers Remain Idle Since September
top_signals.summary: No Iran-affiliated tanker still transmitting AIS in the Middle East Gulf has shown a draft change indicative of loading since September 17. Before then, MIOC detected only seven AIS-transmitting tankers loading almost 6 million barrels between July 27 and September 17…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Circle’s ARC token sale lifts earnings as lower yields weigh on USDC income
top_signals.summary: Circle is looking to payments fees and future staking rewards to diversify revenue as its core stablecoin business faces pressure from lower yields and growing competition.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: MUFG Emut Bank to operate without cash cards
top_signals.summary: MUFG Emut will be the first bank affiliated with a major Japanese financial group not to issue cash cards.
